title: Severed Head

sources.title: Severed Head
markers: | description = '''Severed Head''' is a common miscellaneous item. Primarily of use for bartering or sale to [[Traders]].

summary: Can open Balthazar’s hidden chamber as an alternative to a heart.

fields.Use: Expose the Ancient Altar behind Musty Tomes at Moonrise Towers and insert a severed head to unlock the secret room. This is the generic head, separate from named quest heads.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
